container_system_status.stdout: apiserver is not running and not registered with launchd

launchd_observation.system_com_apple_container_apiserver: Could not find service in system domain
launchd_observation.gui_501_com_apple_container_apiserver: Could not find service in user domain

probable_cause: container system start has an implicit kernel install policy prompt by default; the B2-R1 runner captured subprocess output without a TTY and did not bind an explicit kernel install policy in the contract.
resolution: Prepare B2-R2 with an explicit contract-bound runtime_start_command using --disable-kernel-install and include bounded command output in future failure JSON.
